Lifelike full spruce: Designed with full spruce shape, featuring mostly tips mould from natural branches, this realistic Christmas tree beautifully recreates the natural charm for a truly authentic festive feel in your home.
Impressive fullness: With 2942 densely packed tips across 119 cm width, this 7 ft Christmas tree creates a beautifully silhouette far fuller than standard trees with only 1300-1700 tips, bringing a rich presence.
Easy assembly: With a simple sections design, hinged branches and mould branches (required little shaping), putting up this Christmas tree is quick and tool-free, for about 35-40 minutes giving you more time for family festivities.
Flame-retardant branches: Crafted from tested with fire-retardant properties, each branch is designed for safe enjoyment year after year. Place the fake Christmas tree beside your fireplace and bask in the warm, inviting glow without concerns.
Stable and foldable stand: Equipped with a reinforced metal base, the 7 foot Christmas tree stays upright and secure. Foldable design allows for incredibly easy storage once the festivities are over.

This pre-lit Noble Fir Christmas tree brings a real festive feel to your home. It has 1,128 branch tips and a snowy white finish, it looks full, frosted, and natural. Lights that seem to glow from within the snow, the perfect centrepiece for cosy family evenings.
Heavy-Duty Steel Stand for Extra Stability: Equipped with a 32mm steel centre pole and a 55cm 5-leg metal base, this tree stands firmly on any floor. The robust construction ensures it won’t tip over, even decorated with heavy ornaments or lights – ideal for homes with children or pets.

When the festive season ends, the sections pull apart easily, taking up minimal space in storage. Ready to use again for many Christmases to come.
The Perfect Christmas Centrepiece: Whether placed in your living room, office, or at a holiday party, this tree creates an instant festive atmosphere. A wonderful gift for family and friends.

Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Product details

Includes one unit per pack, allowing you to coordinate multiple ornaments to create a consistent and visually appealing holiday look.

Christmas Tree Decorations
These Christmas tree decorations add a festive detail to your Christmas display. The gold finish and polyester construction give them a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Glitter Finish
The glitter finish adds a light catching detail to the surface. It brings a more textured appearance to the decorative arrangement and pairs well with plain finishes when you want the smaller design elements to remain visible.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Material: Polyester. Colour: Gold. Product measurements: length 30 cm, width 14 cm, height 14 cm. Quantity: 24 pack.
Glitter finish adds a light-catching detail to the surface for a textured appearance.
Lightweight design makes them convenient to handle and easy to store in bags.
Polyester construction provides durability while maintaining a festive gold look.
Pack of 24 ornaments allows you to create a coordinated focal point on your tree.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Included: 24 x Christmas tree decorations

Constructed from quality materials, these 11cm tall robins are durable enough for seasonal reuse, ensuring they become a cherished part of your holiday traditions for years to come. Their cheerful appearance is suitable for both traditional and contemporary décor themes, adding warmth and character to any room. A set provides ample quantity to create a cohesive and impactful decorative scheme throughout your home.

Whether you're looking to fill out a sparse tree, add life to a mantelpiece display, or create a themed tablescape, these clip-on robins provide a simple yet effective solution. Their classic design ensures they never go out of style, making them a wonderful addition to any collection of Christmas ornaments.

8941467526431.sourceDescription:
These burgundy velvet ribbon bows are made from soft velvet that feels smooth in the hand and brings a warm, traditional festive feel to a room. The deep burgundy tone sits comfortably alongside classic red and green schemes, and it also works with more muted neutral styling, so the same bows can be brought out again each Christmas. Velvet has a soft matte surface that catches the light gently rather than shining, which keeps the decoration calm next to tinsel, glitter and fairy lights.

Each bow measures approximately 5 x 10 in (13 x 26 cm) and the ribbon itself is 1 in wide. The generous size makes the bows easy to spot from across a room, whether they are spaced along the branches of a tree or gathered together on a door or wreath, and the wide ribbon gives every bow a full, rounded shape.

The pack contains 12 bows. Tie them onto Christmas trees, wreaths and garlands, or use them on gifts, windows, doors, walls, stair rails and fireplaces. They also work as finishing touches for a party table, a wedding or a picnic, and they suit a home, an office or a shop display.

The classic velvet ribbon shape keeps the decoration simple and elegant rather than busy, so the bows layer happily with baubles, greenery and lights, and they hold their own where space is tight. They make a practical gift for anyone who enjoys crafting and DIY, and they can be used to dress wrapped presents before handing them to family, friends or colleagues.

A flat acrylic bauble that looks three-dimensional on the tree, thanks to high-definition printing that gives real depth to the picture — so it reads as more than a printed card hanging from a branch.

This one features a cheerful snowman wrapped round a bright festive initial, surrounded by little details like bells, snowflakes and stockings. At just under four millimetres thick it's substantial enough to feel like a proper decoration while staying light enough not to bend a branch.

It comes with a metallic gold cord already tied, so it can go straight on the tree out of the box. Unlike glass there's no risk of anything shattering on a hard floor, and being flat it packs away without needing bubble wrap.

Under 4 mm thick yet still feels substantial

If you're stuck for a housewarming present that isn't a bottle of wine, this is a good shout: three metal flowers in a warm gold-beige, each about 35 x 15 cm, with cut-out petals and leaves that give them a bit of depth on the wall.

They're pressed from metal with a smooth coated finish, so they're waterproof as well as durable — a bathroom, a kitchen or a covered porch is no problem. The neutral gold tone means they don't clash with much, which is handy when you don't know someone's colour scheme.

Hang them as a trio, scatter them across a wall, or dot them about the house. Adhesive dots are included, so there's nothing to drill and nothing to patch up afterwards. Simple to put up, and they look considerably more expensive than they are.

Weight: 332 g | Material: Powder-coated metal

Warm neutral tone that suits most schemes
Waterproof coated metal, fine in bathrooms
Stick on with the glue dots provided
A housewarming gift that isn't another candle

Bring a bold, modern glow to your Christmas display with this 60 x 48cm LED neon bell from MySmartBuy. Warm white SMD LEDs create a vibrant neon-style outline that stands out after dark. A cheerful festive bell for walls, porches and entrances. It is supplied with a 5m lead cable and IP20 transformer, giving plenty of reach from your socket, and the built-in timer lights it for 6 hours and then switches it off for 18 hours, so it comes on at the same time every evening without you needing to remember. Light up figures are one of the easiest ways to make your home stand out at Christmas. Group several together to tell a festive story on the lawn, use them to frame the front door or path, or place one where it can be seen from the window so the whole family can enjoy it from inside too. Pair it with other MySmartBuy light up figures, trees and wreaths to build a full festive display that neighbours, visitors and passers-by will love. At a glance: 60 x 48cm neon bell | warm white SMD LEDs | 5m lead cable | IP20 transformer | 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer | outdoor use.

 damp soft cloth. Sturdy built‑in gold twist ties resist bending even with frequent re‑fastening.

PRE‑SHAPED BOWS WITH TWIST TIES FOR FAST DECOR: No tedious hand‑tying needed. Each pre‑formed symmetrical bow measures 3.54 in width & height. Secure directly to gift handles, tree branches and crafts via gold twist ties, no extra tape or rope required.

COMPACT SIZE FOR DETAIL‑ORIENTED DECOR: 3.54"×3.54" with 1‑inch ribbon width. Lightweight mini bows fit small spots too tiny for large bows, and will not weigh down thin tree branches, ornaments or gift wrapping. Maintains full 3D plump shape, avoids
 getting flat after long‑term display.

VERSATILE MULTI‑SCENE HOLIDAY DECOR:Great for Christmas trees, wreaths, candy jars, gift bags, advent calendars, candle holders and party favors. Classic velvet complements farmhouse, vintage, pastel and cottage‑style holiday decor. Also works for winter
 birthdays and winter weddings.

BULK SUPPLIES FOR CRAFT ENTHUSIASTS & RESELLERS: Durable velvet, convenient built‑in twist ties and ready‑to‑use pre‑tied design. Excellent bulk holiday ornament bows, ideal for DIY craft projects, holiday decorating and retail resale.
Soft Premium Velvet Fabric Fine-Trimmed Long-Lasting Craftsmanship: These pre-tied mini bows are made of high-grade velvet cloth that boasts luxuriously plush tactile feel and subtle matte sheen. Tight textile weaving greatly lowers the risk of lint shedding, fading and unwanted wrinkling through repeated holiday usage and storage. All ribbon edges receive neat hemming treatment to prevent fraying, and minor surface dust can be wiped away effortlessly with soft damp cloths. Integrated gold twist ties adopt sturdy metallic craftsmanship, not easy to bend out of shape during repeated fastening operations.
Pre-Shaped Compact Bow with Built-in Gold Twist Ties for Effortless Setup: Distinct from loose DIY velvet ribbon that requires tedious hand-tying work, every bow comes pre-formed into a symmetrical delicate silhouette measuring 3.54in both in width and height. The attached gold twist ties allow you to fasten the bows onto package handles, tree twigs and craft accessories directly without extra ropes or adhesive tapes. You can tighten or readjust the fixation whenever you need, delivering much higher decorating efficiency especially during busy Christmas preparation periods.
Petite Proper Dimensions for Fine Detail Embellishment: With compact overall measurements of 3.54in × 3.54in and 1in-wide ribbon strips, these mini bows occupy limited space and work perfectly for detailed decoration spots that large-sized bows cannot fit. Their lightweight construction will not weigh down slender Christmas tree branches, small ornament pendants or thin gift wrapping paper. The neat bow outline maintains plump three-dimensional looks after long placement and avoids flattened, shapeless appearances.
Versatile Christmas-Focused Multi-Scene Decoration Options: The bows fit a broad array of festive decorating needs centered around Christmas. You may adorn miniature Christmas tree branches, wreath gaps, holiday candy jars, festive gift bags, advent calendars, candle holders and party favor packs with them. The timeless velvet texture coordinates beautifully with farmhouse Christmas decor, classic vintage festive layouts, pastel-themed holiday styling and cozy cottage decoration aesthetics, also usable for winter birthday and winter wedding adornment outside Christmas season.
Practical Bulk Craft Supplies Suitable for Holiday Crafters and Retail Sellers: Featuring durable velvet fabric, convenient built-in twist ties and dainty pre-made bow styling, these ornament bows serve as wonderful bulk holiday supplies. They are great picks for DIY
Resistant to shattering

Production Features:

 Set of 12pcs 6cm velvet flocked Christmas baubles includes two styles: plain solid round balls and concave convex wavy ribbed balls for diversified decorative look.
 Luxurious flocked velvet exterior creates soft tactile feeling and matte retro aesthetic, greatly upgrading the overall grade of Christmas layout.
 Sturdy plastic core with drop-resistant performance, reusable for many holiday seasons without easy deformation or cracking.
 Pre-installed hanging cords allow quick and convenient hanging installation on various holiday decorative layouts.

 Material: Plastic Inner Base + Flocked Velvet Surface
 Size: 6cm per ball
 Quantity: 12 Pieces per box
 Two Styles: Smooth Solid Round / Wavy Ribbed Textured
 Accessories: Metal Hanging Cap + Attached Hanging String

 6cm Flocked Velvet Christmas Balls × 12

5037204489831.sourceDescription:
Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and wood construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Product details
Material: Wood. Colour: Green. Stated size: 30 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Festive green wood wreath adds a defined decorative detail to your Christmas display.
Compact 30 cm size allows flexible placement on doors, walls or mantelpieces.
Constructed from durable wood with a classic green finish for seasonal charm.
Single item pack designed to create a focal point in your holiday arrangements.
Comes with 1 x Christmas Wreath

Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and fabric construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Zip Fastening
The zip fastening keeps the opening together while allowing direct access when needed. Open it fully to arrange the contents and close it before carrying or storing the item.

Carry Handle
The handle provides a defined place to hold the item when moving it. It is useful for carrying between locations and returning it to storage after use.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Create a focal point

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Inflatable Santa
This inflatable santa adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and fabric construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Fabric. Colour: Red. Stated size: 130 x 82 x 195 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Festive Father Christmas motif adds a recognisable seasonal focal point to your Christmas display.
Fabric construction in red provides a defined appearance suitable for indoor or outdoor holiday decorating.
Compact footprint of 130 x 82 cm allows flexible placement within coordinated decorative arrangements.
Easy to move and reposition, allowing you to refresh your festive display with small spacing adjustments.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for: Outdoor use
Comes with 1 piece

5059442204731.sourceDescription:
Norway Spruce has the unmistakable shape of a traditional Christmas tree, with dark green foliage, a neat conical outline, and branches that angle upwards to create a naturally attractive silhouette. The stiff, pointed needles give it a distinctly spruce-like appearance, while the strong branches provide plenty of support for your favourite decorations. A strong pine fragrance completes the experience, bringing the familiar scent of a real Christmas tree into the home.
STRONG, UPWARD-FACING BRANCHES: The branches of Norway Spruce angle upwards to create its characteristic Christmas-tree shape, while their strength provides good support for lights, baubles, and other decorations. The natural spacing also allows the shape of the tree to remain visible once it is decorated.
WHY CHOOSE POT-GROWN CHRISTMAS TREES?: This tree has been grown in its pot from the beginning, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container shortly before sale. Its roots have had time to develop within the pot as the tree has grown, without the disturbance of being dug up and moved. This makes it better suited to continuing its growth after Christmas, with a more established root system already growing in the pot. Unlike potted Christmas trees that have only recently been transferred from the ground, it can be kept outdoors and grown on after the festive season.
A REAL CHRISTMAS TREE WITH A PINE SCENT: Norway Spruce has the distinctive fragrance associated with traditional spruce trees, adding a natural Christmassy scent to the room that adds to the magic of the season.
GROW IT AS AN OUTDOOR CHRISTMAS TREE: Once the festive period is over, move the tree outdoors where it can continue growing. Its evergreen foliage provides year-round colour, making it suitable for inclusion among evergreen trees for garden planting.
A POTTED REAL CHRISTMAS TREE WITH ROOM TO DEVELOP: The container provides a practical way to keep the tree growing while it is still young, without committing immediately to a permanent planting position. These live potted Christmas trees can therefore be enjoyed as Christmas trees while also being given the opportunity to become a long-term feature in the garden.
Please Note: Our pot grown trees are measured from the base of the pot to the tip of the tree.
Manufacturer guarantee: Statutory

The original Christmas tree, the Norway Spruce has been grown in the UK since Victorian times and is the variety most people picture at Christmas. Its classic conical shape, dark green foliage and fresh scent bring a traditional, nostalgic feel to your home, and its firm, slightly prickly needles are ideal for hanging decorations. Norway Spruce can drop needles if it dries out, so keeping it well watered is key. Our trees are grown in the UK and freshly cut before dispatch. When your tree arrives, cut a few centimetres from the base of the trunk and stand it in water straight away. Keep it in a stand with a water reservoir, topped up every 1-2 days, and away from radiators and fires so it stays fresh throughout Christmas.

PREMIUM QUALITY, FRESH FROM THE FARM - Our Christmas trees are grown in the UK, ensuring the highest growing standards, and cared for year round by our expert team
TRADITIONAL LOOK AND FEEL - The classic Christmas tree look, with dark green foliage and firm, slightly prickly needles that are ideal for hanging decorations
STAND SOLD SEPARATELY - A stand with a water reservoir is vital for keeping your tree fresh. Pop your tree in, fill it with water and you're ready to decorate
CARE GUIDE SUPPLIED WITH EVERY TREE - Keep your tree in top condition with our free step-by-step care guide. This gives tips on prepping, watering and decorating your tree.
